messages:
alice_csm: FYI flagged account 'Northbridge Analytics' as at-risk — renewal ~2026-06-12, daily active usage down ~50% vs last quarter. Onboarding still on step 3 (SAML + webhook tests).
ben_csm: Noted. Quick triage: 1) health call, 2) unblock SAML tests, 3) short-term downgrade path w/ limited features, 4) capture post-call feedback.
priya_se: I can take SAML test debugging. Can someone drop the logs and the test curl here?
alice_csm: paste from their support ticket: `504 during /auth/saml/callback` then `webhook: timeout 30s, endpoint 522` — they said their infra team is stretched.
priya_se: ok looks like our assertion consumer endpoint is timing out on their side. @marco_ae can you nudge their infra contact to allowlist our IPs? That buys time.
marco_ae: pinged their infra (cc: @marco_ae). Also offered an "emergency runbook" where we temporarily enable token-based auth for their integration. They said they'd prefer we avoid extra security changes.
ben_csm: For the playbook we should propose a downgrade path that preserves core search/query but removes advanced reranking and realtime billing to cut cost by ~30% — called 'Lean' tier. Offer a 60d trial of 'Lean' + 1-hour migration assist.
liz_cs_ops: I can create the Lean SKU and a migration checklist. Suggested checklist snippet:
```
- Verify core routes: /v1/query, /v1/embeddings
- Disable realtime rerank pipeline
- Set rate limit to 60rps
- Enable KV prefix caching for top-5 queries
- Communicate feature gaps in an email template
```
ben_csm: also propose a $0 setup migration assist (1 engineer hour) + 20% off for first billing period. Use this as a win-back incentive.
alice_csm: schedule health call tomorrow 10am PT? I'll send calendar invite and pre-call form to gather what broke, who owns certs, and success criteria. Include a short NPS-like question for qualitative feedback.
priya_se: I'll join 10am and try the token fallback if they agree. If token fallback works we avoid more intrusive infra requests.
onboarding-bot: Reminder: "Pre-call checklist" form sent to customer (link: https://redwood.internal/forms/pre-call).
marco_ae: Next steps owner map: Alice -> customer comms & call; Priya -> SAML debugging + fallback; Liz -> Lean SKU + migration checklist; Ben -> offer details & pricing; Marco -> AE escalation & infra contact.
ben_csm: Also capture churn reason tags in Salesforce: 'onboarding_blocker', 'infra_timeout', 'cost_pressure'. I'll update the account record after the call.
alice_csm: If call goes poorly, escalate to fast-track renewal save: 3mo discounted commit + Dedicated trial. If call goes well, follow-up plan: 14-day check-in and run our usage uplift play (email drip + 2 enablement sessions). :white_check_mark:
priya_se: sounds good. I'll prepare a short demo showing the Lean tier difference (2 slides).
alice_csm: thanks team — will update thread after call with outcome and action items. :eyes:
